prompt_short: I want to publish but haven't set up the service account yet

assertions.text: Response lists prerequisite setup steps (service account and/or OM_TOKEN)
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md Prerequisites section lists: Python 3.8+, requests, OM instance, vocab-publisher-bot service account, VocabPublisherPolicy, OM_TOKEN env var — agent surfaces these.

assertions.text: Response references vocab-publisher-bot or equivalent service account
assertions.evidence: Prerequisites section names 'vocab-publisher-bot service account' explicitly; Step 4/5 troubleshooting also references it.

assertions.text: Response does NOT proceed to run the script before prerequisites are confirmed
assertions.evidence: Step 1 requires OM_TOKEN to be set before proceeding; with the user explicitly stating setup is incomplete, the agent stops at Step 1 and surfaces prerequisites.
